fix.ctx: The world's largest underground copper mine, with more than 3,000 km of tunnels, run by state-owned Codelco in the Andes east of Rancagua. Industrial mining began in 1906 under the US Braden Copper Company (later Kennecott) before Chile nationalised it in 1971. A collapse after a tremor on 31 July 2025 killed six miners.
